The '''metal gauntlets''' are a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' in the possession of the [[White Tower]].

==Appearance==
The gauntlets are very large, with firedrops decorating the metal cuffs.

==Use==
The use of the gauntlets is unknown, as they were only seen in passing in the White Tower's storeroom by [[Egwene al'Vere]].{{ref/book|12|40}}
